scope: Simple pair bench (original with hook off vs candidate with hook on), 3840 isolated CPU pairs for 7 functions of CTaskSimpleFightingControl (3) and CTaskComplexProstituteSolicit (4) with a loaded save game, zero differences, natural completion event with state_restored, layout ok, saves unchanged, configs restored. Fixtures: peds, target entity, vehicles, intelligence, player data, fake tasks (traced vtable) and a fake event (traced vtable with priority and type) in private buffers with raw EXE offsets; x87 forced to 24 bits. Compared: return value, full memory of the tested object, new pool tasks (type + words without vptr), memory of the fake tasks, fingerprint of every buffer (references masked), reference lists before and after deletion, the full trace (order and number of virtual calls and rand calls), x87 control word and empty x87 stack (FpuTag); pool m_LastFreeSlot and the 0xCD fill of free slots, patched entries, vtable slots and the time step are checked at start and restored at the end. Traced stubs, patched at the EXE address and at the DLL body and acting only on the bank thread, so these helpers get NO credit: rand 0x821B1E, FindPlayerPed 0x56E210, CPedGeometryAnalyser::ComputeEntityBoundingBoxPlanes 0x5F3660, ComputeEntityHitSide 0x5F3AC0, IsPlayerOnAMission 0x464D50, IsCoopGameGoingOn 0x441390. Run for real: FindTaskByType, GetSimplestActiveTask, GetTaskFighting, GetVehicleAppearance, IsUpsideDown, IsOnItsSide, Normalise, the task pool (tasks created by Clone are found in the pool and deleted) and references. Limits: the ProstituteSolicit destructor runs with FindPlayerPed returning null when the pool tasks created by Clone are deleted (early exit), so that deletion only proves the pool ends clean; CTaskComplexProstituteSolicit::Clone with a null client is NOT tested (the EXE and DLL constructors dereference the client). GetTaskPool/IsFreeSlotAtIndex/GetAt and the 0x80 per-slot offsets are copied from TasksBatch4. Source corrected to what the EXE does before this run: CTaskSimpleFightingControl::CalcMoveCommand (7 differences: bearing subtracted from the rotation before wrapping with a single-turn wrap; strict threshold 0x8D2E60 (0.2617993950843811) instead of DegreesToRadians(15); the EXE rand is always consumed; the 0.8 threshold compares the magnitude; vehicle sum z^2+x^2+y^2 with strict >0.7; 64-bit _ftol2 for the time step; fpatan) and its vehicle branch now calls ComputeEntityBoundingBoxPlanes (0x5F3660) instead of the UncachedAll variant; CTaskSimpleFightingControl::MakeAbortable (priorities other than 0/1/2 fall to the end instead of NOTSA_UNREACHABLE, GetEventType repeated per comparison, dot product (y*ny+z*nz)+x*nx and threshold 0.707). CTaskComplexProstituteSolicit: no source changes. Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation.
